title: Novel benzothiazole-indole acetamides as potential anticancer agents: synthesis, biological evaluation, and in silico studies
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,30111-30123
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08263C, Paper

Nazanin Motamedi Shakib, Manica Negahdaripour, Mohammad Hosein Sayahi, Navid Dastyafteh, Zahra Dehghani, Mina Emami, Sajedeh Safapoor, Younes Ghasemi, Seyedeh Niloufar Ghafouri, Abbas Ghahramani, Mohammad Reza Mohajeri-Tehrani, Bagher Larijani, Mohammad Mahdavi, Sara Ranjbar
Benzothiazole-indole hybrids were synthesized and evaluated for antiproliferative effects. The most potent derivative was subjected to cell cycle and apoptosis investigations. Compound 9d is suggested as a promising anticancer agent.
